Messages.Author: bakija
Messages.Body:
A vampire has Enkil Cog and has 0 blood. At the end of another player's minion phase, Enkil Cog is tapped to give the vampire an out of turn action.

Can that vampire with 0 blood bleed, or is it compelled to hunt (if it takes an action at all vis Enkil Cog)?

Thanks!

Messages.Author: emime
Messages.Body:
If he takes an action, then he must hunt. See also Madness Network ( groups.google.com/group/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/msg/6ebd217344f0c7c4 ).

Emiliano "Sans Terre" - Wandering Player - Prince of Brussels

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:
emime's answer is correct.
